latest.notes: Fixes the weather segment stalling every hour and its elements airing later out of position. Two causes. (1) An interrupted download leaves a zero-byte file on disk; the 'is the voiceover present?' check only asked whether a file EXISTS, so an empty file counted as present and the segment aired with a 0:00 read — stalling the log. Present now means real audio on disk, so a failed download means the segment does not air at all, as intended. (2) The segment's bed hand-off briefly idles by design; the code required the bed to be the first pending row in the whole log, while the hand-off had chosen it as the next row after the current element. Any stale row earlier in the log masked it, the hand-off was misread as a stall, and the segment was skipped — leaving its rows to break the next hour, every hour. The bed is now matched by identity.
